summary.text: Lisa Demuth is Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives and the Republican nominee for governor with running mate Ryan Wilson, an attorney and the party's 2022 state auditor nominee. She has represented District 13A in central Minnesota since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Born in Paynesville, Minnesota; served 11 years on the ROCORI school board and ran a small business before entering the Legislature.

First elected to the Minnesota House in 2018; elected House Republican leader in 2022 and Speaker on February 6, 2025 under a power-sharing agreement that ended a DFL boycott, after the Minnesota Supreme Court ruled that her January election lacked a quorum. Her campaign says she was the first Black lawmaker to serve as Speaker.
